summary.summary:
* An update on Ethiopia's humanitarian response for 2025 has been published by the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4167767)

* Ethiopian farmers are revamping age-old growing practices, described as "life-changing" by the World Food Programme. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4167221)

* Key findings from the Ethiopia Solutions Index as of February 2025 have been released by the International Organization for Migration. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4167201)
⚕️
* The Ethiopia Health Cluster Bulletin for June 2025 provides an update on the health situation. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4167159)

* UNHCR reports on the population of concern in Ethiopia and the broader East, Horn of Africa, and Great Lakes region as of June 30, 2025. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4167025)

* Minutes from the Ethiopia WASH Cluster ETF meeting held on July 15, 2025, are available from UNICEF. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4166865)

* Ethiopia is experiencing severe weather, as reported in the ECHO Daily Flash of July 23, 2025, by DG ECHO, Ethiopian Red Cross Society, and others. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4166702)

* An infographic providing a monthly overview of operations in Ethiopia for June 2025 has been released by the Logistics Cluster. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4166413)

* The Ethiopia ES/NFI Cluster's Mid-Year Report 2025 details progress, challenges, and voices from the field as of July 2025. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4166067)

* A Joint Cash Feasibility Assessment (JCFA) was conducted in Ethiopia from March 3-14, 2025, by the REACH Initiative. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4165835)
